ERR_ACTION_NOT_FOUND.hint: Write the project to the board (toolbar), or check which action is called.

ERR_ACTION_BUSY.message: A recording or upload is already open

ERR_ACTION_NO_SESSION.message: No recording or upload is open

ERR_ACTION_TOO_BIG.message: The action is {len} bytes; at most {max} fit
ERR_ACTION_TOO_BIG.hint: Split the action into smaller ones.

ERR_ACTION_OFFSET.message: The upload is out of order (at {got}, expected {want})

ERR_ACTION_INCOMPLETE.message: The upload is incomplete ({got} of {want} bytes)

ERR_ACTION_BAD_FRAME.message: The action is broken at byte {offset}

ERR_ACTION_EMPTY.hint: Add a command to the action.

ERR_ACTION_DEPTH.message: Actions run each other {depth} levels deep: too deep
ERR_ACTION_DEPTH.hint: Make the actions call each other less deep.

ERR_ACTION_WRONG_TASK.message: An action was started from the wrong place

ERR_ACTION_NO_MEM.message: No memory for the action ({size} bytes)

ERR_ACTION_BAD_ARG.message: An action request is not valid
